name: Kamino Lend, main market (SOL/BTC)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: Upgrades wait 24 hours and risk changes 12, but a ten-signer group can re-map the price source behind the SOL and USDC reserves with no delay, even to a fixed price. That undelayed path caps the oracle sub-score.
narrative.detail: Seven authority paths exist and four feed a score. Program upgrade is a 5-of-10 Squads v4 multisig with a 24h delay, the market owner is 4-of-10 with 12h, the Scope price aggregator admin is 4-of-10 with none, and Scope's own upgrade is 5-of-10 with 24h. The upgrade, Scope admin and Scope upgrade multisigs use the same 10 keys, and the market owner shares 9 of them. Klend rejects prices more than 1,000 bps (SOL) or 300 bps (USDC) from the TWAP, but the same admin can re-map the TWAP source, so no credit was given. Scoring the providers behind Scope is still open, and the emergency council (restrict-only) has an unresolved controller.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 5-of-10 of 10 plain keys; delay: 24 h Squads time lock
